newsitem.title: USA: Central Garden & Pet to offer 5 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Central Garden & Pet to offer 5 mln shrs.

text.p: Central Garden & Pet Co said it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission with respect to a proposed public offering of 5,000,000 shares of its common stock.

Alex Brown & Sons Inc will lead-manage the underwriting group with Hambrecht & Quist LLC, Merrill Lynch, Pierce, Fenner & Smith Inc and Wasserstein Perella Securities Inc serving as co-managers, the company said.
The company said it will offer 4,790,000 shares and certain selling stockholders will offer the remaining 210,000 shares to the public.
A maximum of 750,000 additional shares may be sold by the company pursuant to an over-allotment option granted to the underwriters, the company said.
The net proceeds to the company from the offering will be used to repay certain outstanding indebtedness and to finance future acquisitions, the company said.
The company said it will not receive any proceeds from the sale of the shares by the selling stockholders.
